name: apex26-desktop
description: Unofficial fan racing game — desktop shell for the Apex 26 static WebGL2 site.
author: Apex 26 contributors

scripts.prestart: npm run sync-version && npm run stage
scripts.smoke: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && electron . --smoke
scripts.pack: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.test:electron:pack: npm run pack:test && npm run test:electron
scripts.pack:test: npm run sync-version && npm run stage && npm run prebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir -c.electronFuses.enableNodeCliInspectArguments=true
